note: one declarative source for every storefront verdict supports. read by extension/src/extract/sites.ts, which derives url parsing, review page urls, the content script matches, the bridge allowlist, and the thumbnail host allowlist from it. adding a storefront is an entry here plus a rules file in extension/src/extract/rules and its line in extension/src/extract/bundledRules.ts, and bundledRules.test.ts checks all three against each other so a missing one fails the build rather than shipping a storefront nothing can read. the id becomes a path segment in the signed rules url, so it stays lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. imageHosts names the cdn hosts a thumbnail may point at beyond the storefront hosts themselves, and anything else is dropped rather than rendered.
